source_of_claims: SKILL.md, 'Reflex-loaded prose' (the third SCR reading and the firing test)

assertions.claim: In a reflex index the curation is the artifact: which entries exist, what each one-line rule says, what was refused admission. Rhetorica dominates the core.
Rhetorica carries about half the compressed core, the profile SKILL.md's genre table gives for a reflex index.
Reflex entries pack a rule, its trigger and its riders into one unbroken chunk, so the layout-chunk median runs long: the memory-index end of the working-markdown chunk-length spectrum.
This genre is read with the firing test, not RI: high retrievability is the function, not waste, and the editorial number is the fire rate, which is analyst judgment with no mechanical instrument.
